papers.title: Mortgage denial and neighborhood change
papers.abstract: We study loan denial rates across census tracts using administrative lending records from 2010 to 2018.

chunks.text: Our data come from the public HMDA loan-application register, 2010-2018, aggregated to the census tract. The key variables are the loan-denial rate and the loan-to-value ratio.
Denial rates fall by 2 points in treated tracts.

papers.title: House prices after zoning reform
papers.abstract: Zoning reform and prices in a large metropolitan area.

chunks.text: We use Zillow ZTRAX transaction records, 2005-2019, at the parcel level; the outcome is the log sale price.
The sample is the restricted-access PSID, 1990-2015, household-year observations; the outcome is a move indicator.
We compare estimators on simulated panels; no observational dataset is used.
